label: Ninesliced
description: A game making band
longDescription:
Ninesliced is a game-making band that I co-created in 2024 in sunny Montpellier with a bunch of friends, under our common love for creating things.
It was made with the idea of having being borderless, in its team, but also in its ideas.

label: Bugscraper
description: Rise to the top of a bug-filled skyscraper
longDescription:
Welcome to the Bugscraper.
Bugscraper is a solo or co-op roguelike shooter. As you climb toward your tyrannical boss's office, you'll battle floor after floor of enemies. Using a wide arsenal of weapons and upgrades, mow them down and aim for the top!

This game was made using LÖVE, a Lua game framework. It is the result of almost 3 years of development. I was responsible for nearly everything: code, art, design, marketing; except for music (made by OLX) and sound design (made by Martin Domergue).

label: Globs
description: Meet the size-changing Globs in this colorful puzzle game
longDescription:
Meet the size-changing Globs in this colorful puzzle game. Use the curious properties of their bodies at your advantage to solve a variety of puzzles, all in a expressive pixel art aesthetic and upbeat soundtrack.
The puzzles are designed to be approachable, but provide additional optional challenges for players wishing to put their puzzle-solving skills to the test. Discover 40 levels across 4 different worlds.

This game was originally made for the GMTK Game Jam 2024 in a team of 5, and seeing that the game had potential for a full release, we continued working on it afterwards. It was made using Godot. I was responsible for system and gameplay programming, and art.

label: Birds With Guns
description: Mess with the Flock, you get the Glock
longDescription:
Are you ready to have a quacking time? Toucan play this egg-citing game right now! Made by an im-peck-able team of quail-ified developers, you're gonna have no egrets.

Birds With Guns is a game I made with a friend over the course of a vacation using PICO-8.

label: Pico Dino
description: Reimagining Google Chrome's secret game
longDescription:
Pico Dino is what came out as I tried to make something simple, but as polished as possible. I really like complexity that rises from simple things, so I found it very fun trying to come up with a complex moveset from a very simple 2-button control scheme. I originally wanted to add different worlds, power-ups, more enemies, but at some point I had to make something I could actually finish. Nonetherless, I'm quite pleased with how it turned out.

I sent my game by email to Edward Jung, one of the two creators of the original game, and he seemed to love it, which made me very happy.

label: Shotcave
description: A Minecraft roguelike plugin
longDescription:
Shotcave is a cooperative or solo roguelike Minecraft Bukkit plugin. It takes place in an abandoned mine composed of randomly generated levels. Players must defeat enemies at every level to progress. To do so, they are equipped with weapons like swords and guns. If all players die, the game ends and all progress is lost permanently.

The plugin is currently unfinished and we're planning on continuing development at a later date, but you can take a look at the presentation document.

label: Minesweeper Royale
description: Minesweeper, but it's a battle royale.
longDescription:
Minesweeper Royale is what minesweeper would be like if it were a battle royale game. Multiple players compete to be the fastest to complete the same minesweeper board, or to be the last one alive. This game is complete with a chat system and a display showing all the player boards. This was my first ever attempt at networking, using the LÖVE framework and luasocket. It was a project I made for school, hence I didn't release any executables for it.

During my attempts to make it work, I have rarely managed to make it work across multiple computers, but it does work locally. I encourage you to take a look at the source code.

label: Montic (GMTK Game Jam 2026 Edition)
description: Time is Monkey
longDescription:
Protect spacetime from an invasion of time-eating termites in this turn-based defense game.

Originally made for GMTK Game Jam 2026!

label: ROQUIN
description: Rocks vs Sharks
longDescription:
Build your island and defend your precious rock against sharks. And The Rock.

Made using Godot for Micro Jam 61, under the theme "Islands" and limitation "You Start With Nothing".

label: Bal Cosmique
description: Create evil masks as a mischievous wizard
longDescription:
Bal Cosmique is a 2-player communication game inspired by 'Keep Talking And Nobody Explodes'.

You play the role of a mischievous wizard, and with the help of your apprentice, you create masks. Alas, your customers are demanding, and so you wish to curse them. To do this, you must communicate with your friend to find out the right way to curse them using your trusty Manual.

This game is in French only. It was created for Global Game Jam 2026.

label: Moo Moo Ranch
description: A game about cows and cow-boys
longDescription:
Sort your cows by looping around them like a true cowboy. (Teehaw!)
Sort your cows into the right colors. The more cows you capture, the higher your combo and multiplier.

This game was created for the GMTK Game Jam 2025.

label: Gemchef
description: Cook gems and earn money
longDescription:
Mine through a dangerous cave system, collect gems, then refine them to earn money.

This game was created for Ludum Dare 57.

label: The Legend of the Goldfish
description: Dive to the bottom of the ocean
longDescription:
You are a diver on a quest to find the legendary Goldfish at the bottom of a trench. Carefully manage your oxygen as you use it to eliminate enemies and get to the bottom of the ocean!

This game was created for Global Game Jam 2025

label: Globs (GMTK Game Jam 2024 Edition)
description: A colorful puzzle game
longDescription:
Meet the size-changing Globs in this colorful puzzle game. Use the curious properties of their bodies at your advantage to solve a variety of levels, all in a lively and expressive pixel art aesthetic and jazzy soundtrack.

This game was created for GMTK Game Jam 2024, and we continued working on it and then released on PC and mobile, which you can learn more about on the corresponding slide on this page.

label: Switch Job
description: Switch your way into this puzzle platformer
longDescription:
People have been hearing strange things about the local warehouse. You're an engineer given the task of inspecting this rusty old building. By cleverly swapping building materials, reach the end of each level and discover what's hiding at the end of the warehouse!

This game was created for GMTK Game Jam 2023

label: Oracle's Inn
description: Practise Malpractice
longDescription:
Welcome to my potion shoppe! I'm glad to have you here. However, I can sense dark waters in your future. I know just the ingredients... In Oracle's Inn, you take the role of alchemist/doctor/oracle/bundle of joy and happen to be just the person your customers need. Catch glimpses into the futures of your customers, and prepare for them live-saving potions in advance!

This game was made in 3 days with Louie Chapman for the Mini Jam 112, following the theme "Chrono" and limitation "Only three buttons".

label: Dice Drop Dash
description: A Dizzying Dance of Dropping Dice
longDescription:
When you drop a dice, its value will be subtracted from the value of the highest in the stack, and the difference will grant you points. Aim for the highest score without overflowing the stack!

This game was made within a tight ~6 hour period rather than the 50 hour period of the GMTK Game Jam 2022, following the theme "Roll of the Dice"

label: Octoboom
description: Ping, Pong, Boom.
longDescription:
Octoboom is a game I made with friends for Ludum Dare 49 in the span of 3 days.
An accident has occurred in the mine and toxic gas is escaping! Flee! Your bomb is your weapon. Throw it on enemies, and catch it before it explodes. The longer you let it fly, the more points it’ll give you, but this is at your own risk.

label: Derailed!
description: A co-op game about building tracks
longDescription:
Derailed! is yet another PICO-8 game I made to challenge myself. It's a co-op game where you need to communicate with a friend to bring a train to its station. It's a fan-made demake of Unrailed!. After I made some concept art for a PICO-8 demake of this game, I thought it would be fun to actually turn it into a real thing. I hope that you'll have fun playing it, and maybe you can grab a friend to try it out.

The game is unfinished and I do not plan to finish it.

label: Anchors & Miners
description: Mining deep down into caves with an anchor
longDescription:
Mine deep down into caves using an anchor! Get gemstones and avoid red explosives, and get the best score!

Made for Ludum Dare 48 based on the theme "Deeper and deeper".

label: Chaser Of Dawn
description: A game about looping around a planet
longDescription:
Chaser Of Dawn is a game that was made for the Ludum Dare 47 game jam. We had 3 days to make a game based on the theme "Stuck in a loop", and we used the Pico-8 engine.
The game was inspired by exoplanets that don't rotate and have a very big difference in temperature between their two sides.
It was a lot of fun and we hope to do more games like this in the future!

label: Interactive Linear Algebra Lesson
longDescription: An experiment made using p5.js to see how an interactive lesson could look like. The idea is to let people play around with vectors and matrices and get an intuitive feeling for how they work before tackling more complex ideas. It's based on my own linear algebra classes at the lycée du Parc (MP2I) and 3blue1brown's excellent video series on this topic.

label: Minecon Earth 2018 Costume Contest
longDescription:
When I was 13 years old, I participated in a Minecraft Cosplay Contest, won and got invited to present it in Boston. This project took me in 3 months in total. All the moving mechanisms use strings, which are pulled from the inside. I still have no idea how I managed to make this pile of cardboard, colored paper and hot glue hold together. We even had to rebuild all of it before heading off to Boston.
It definitely was an incredible experience that I got to remember for years to follow. I even got to meet jeb! By the way, inside the costume is my little sister! She said it was really hot inside.
